tagline: Wood-fired pizza & Italian street food in Offerton, Stockport.
storyText:
La Cucina Povera — 'the poor kitchen'. It's a thing people in the south of Italy have always done: take what you've got, a bit of dough, whatever's good, a proper fire, and make something worth eating. No ceremony. No waste.

This is that. A proper pop-up at Woodbank Park and focaccia out of a converted outhouse on Park Lane. Something we always wanted to do. Now we're doing it.

Every pizza is made when you order it. Nothing sits. Nothing's reheated. You find us, we feed you.
